notes: Type V at m = 16: the smallest real challenge over GF(2^8), at the same n = 24 as the type VI row and therefore served by the same compiled dimension. Underdetermined and so positive-dimensional as published, like type VI. The published figure at this size and seed is a wall-clock total; the 370-second figure the same size carries at seed 2 is per subsystem of a hybrid attack and must never be quoted as a total (docs/research/fukuoka-mq.md section 8.4). No instance bytes and no answer vector are committed; a real challenge publishes no answer at all.
